context: A senpai chats with a teen
purpose: Teach: うんざり/ひさし/正反対/太い/手首/片隅/愛着/立ち止まっ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、最近、レポートが多くて、うんざりだろ。
lines.en: Sakura, you must be sick of all these reports piling up lately.
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, not quite teasing. Leans in with interest. Warm but careful — testing whether she wants to talk. Easy breath, no pressure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先輩とは、ひさしぶりにお話しできて、嬉しいです。
lines.en: Yeah. And it's been a while since we got to talk like this — I'm really glad we did.
lines.style: Soft sincerity breaking through a careful exterior. Small breath after 'yeah' — letting her guard down. Genuine, not performed. Slight lift at the end, vulnerable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 同期の意見、正反対で、まとまらないんだ。
lines.en: My group can't seem to agree on anything. Everyone's pulling in different directions.
lines.style: Rueful, a little tired. Half-laugh underneath — sympathetic complaint. Slower pace, like he's working through the frustration as he speaks. Shaking his head slightly in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 相談相手、太い人脈、先輩持ってるんですね。
lines.en: You really do have a solid network of people you can talk things through with, don't you?
lines.style: Observant, a touch of admiration. Not flattery — genuine noticing. Bright moment in her voice. Quick pace, engaged. The way you point out something good about someone you respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん。今、手首痛めてて、PCも辛い。
lines.en: Yeah. Though honestly, my wrist is killing me right now — even typing feels rough.
lines.style: Slight wince in the opening. Quiet, almost reluctant to complain. Tired but not bitter. The confession of someone who doesn't like to burden others. Trails off slightly, like he's already apologizing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: カフェの片隅、静かで、いい席です。
lines.en: This corner of the café is so quiet — it's a really nice spot.
lines.style: Noticing, gentle. Like she's pointing out a small kindness he didn't realize he was offering. Soft voice, careful not to make too much of it. Warm but restrained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この店、愛着あって、いつも来てる。
lines.en: I've grown attached to this place over time. I come here all the time.
lines.style: Reflective, almost tender. Slow, measured pace. Like he's realizing something about himself as he speaks. Quiet but solid — this is real to him. No irony.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 時々、立ち止まって、振り返るの、大事ですね。
lines.en: It's important to stop sometimes and look back at where you've been — really important.
lines.style: Thoughtful, mature without being preachy. Gentle certainty. Like she's speaking from something she's learned. Breath space between thoughts. Not rushing to fill silence. Warm close.
